_comment: EXTENDED DASHBOARDS ONLY (Release / Sprint Report). CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance: top-level 'conditions'/'orders' (UpdateUserFilterRQ), and 'compositeAttribute' + 'ex' + '<key>' (attribute key exists, regardless of value) is accepted. {{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}} is substituted by provision_dashboards.py from each project's optional 'build_attribute_key' (default 'version') -- see config/teams.example.yml and ci-examples/ATTRIBUTES.md. Recency for the widgets that use this filter is bounded by their itemsCount (10).
name: Recent Releases ({{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}})
description: Launches tagged with a '{{BUILD_ATTRIBUTE_KEY}}' attribute, used to scope Release/Sprint Report comparison widgets.
